summary.name: BlueWillow
summary.one_liner: BlueWillow is a free, prompt-based AI image generator that runs in the browser and now operates as part of LimeWire.
use_cases: Designing logo and brand mark concepts
Creating character art for games or tabletop campaigns
Generating product shots or stock-style photos
summary.what_it_does: BlueWillow turns a plain-English text prompt into images in a few seconds, with a browser-based AI Studio. Users can refine or regenerate results and choose from several models with higher resolutions. Output is square by default, with wider and taller framings and an upscaler for print resolution. The page also covers prompt-writing tips such as naming subject, style, framing and light, and adding negative terms. A Discord community remains open for sharing and prompt ideas.
notable: Free to try without a credit card, browser-based, no Discord account needed
Originally a Discord bot from 2023, now runs on LimeWire's AI Studio
Positioned as a free alternative to Midjourney
caveats: Paid LimeWire plans are needed for more generations, higher resolution and commercial use
Studio sign-up requires entering an email address
Commercial-use terms are governed by LimeWire terms
